Below, a face seen frontally, with short, slicked back hair and a collared shirt and tie indicated around the neck. At bottom left, a face seen in left profile with a cigarette between their lips. In the same frame, below the smoking face, a reclining nude figure leaning on one elbow. Above Two studies that have been crossed out. description.value: Study of a surrealist composition in black and lavender comprised of a full-bodied figure in black, superimposed onto (and also forming) a disembodied face in lavender with waving lavender hair. The full-body figure is depicted with broad shoulders, a narrow waist, and wide hips, standing frontally, and holding amorphous lavender shapes in either hand. The figure’s head is represented by thin, wavy, parallel black lines extending out of the neck area. At the figure’s chest and shoulder area, two black circles surrounded by concentric black ovals within a white ovular form.  The figure’s belly button is formed by a white swirl. The figure’s genital region is depicted by a white tringle bisected by a black line. The depiction of a disembodied face is formed by these three anatomical structures doubly representing eyes, a nose, and a mouth respectively.

inscription.inscribed: Inscribed in brush and lavendar watercolor, at lower right: Adam and Eve
